name: Battle Nap
storyline: A dad falls asleep on a lake floatie mid-vacation and wakes up in a subconscious warzone. Armed with whatever he can find and riding a floatie that lets him dodge through bullet hell, he fights through four surreal dimensions filled with bizarre creatures, escalating chaos, and bosses that exist somewhere between nightmare and fever dream.
summary: Battle Nap is a procedural roguelite twin-stick shooter developed by 1050 Studio. A dad dozes off on a lake floatie and wakes up in a subconscious warzone. Armed with two swappable weapons and a choice of floatie-based dodge mechanics, he must fight his way through 4 dream worlds, full of bizarre creatures and bosses. The arsenal of 15 weapons, stackable perk system, procedurally generated levels, and both temporary and permanent upgrades make every run different, balancing moment-to-moment action chaos with meaningful progression.
